thread:
mara: heads-up: probe-aggregator flagged a nightly regression for the candidate kernel set. latency P95 up ~18% on long-seq profile :eyes:
ci-bot: [alert] nightly-sweep: candidate-kernels: regression_detected metric=serve_latency_p95 baseline=24.3ms now=28.7ms filter=seq_len>2048 arch=ampere
jon: ugh. which kernel(s) are firing? stack traces?
ci-bot: top_candidates: krnl_v3_optim, krnl_v4_prefetch. profiler_dump: s3://redwood-ci/bench/4123456789/trace.tar.gz
devon: grabbing trace now. initial hunch: KV cache churn + batch splitting at boundary causing extra memcopy and backend fallback.
sasha: quick numbers from local microbench (ampere, seq=4096, batch=4):
```
# baseline (krnl_v2_stable)
p95=23.9ms
# krnl_v3_optim
p95=28.4ms
# krnl_v4_prefetch
p95=29.1ms
```
these match CI diffs.
phil: interesting — telemetry shows an uptick in kv_cache_evictions/sec around the same time. Maybe prefetch path increases working set and forces eviction.
mara: is this reproducible with the harness args we run nightly? Devon, can you share the exact bench command you used?
devon: yes — command I ran: `python3 scripts/bench/run_microbench.py --arch=ampere --seq-lens=1024,2048,4096 --batch-sizes=1,2,4 --kernels=candidate --kv-cache=true --repeat=50 --collect=perf,trace`
jon: can you dump the config that autotuner used for those kernels? i want to see selection heuristics and score history.
devon: put the tuner log here: `cat /var/tmp/autotune/run_2026-03-17.log` snippet:
```
# autotuner picks
krnl_v3_optim: score=0.92 (improved for seq<=2048)
krnl_v4_prefetch: score=0.88 (improved avg latency small seq)
fallback_policy: prefer_lower_latency_over_memory
```
looks like the tuner favored small/medium seq behavior; it didn't see long-seq regressions because our sampling underweights >2048.
sasha: i ran an isolated microprobe to stress kv cache churn: `./microprobe --profile kv_churn --seq=4096 --warm=20 --iters=200` results: evictions/sec spikes 3x with krnl_v4_prefetch vs baseline.
phil: suggestion: add a long-seq weighting in the candidate scoring (or a safety penalty for kernels that increase kv_evictions by >1.5x). That would keep tuner from choosing prefetched path for long sequences.
mara: agreed. also we should add a targeted microbenchmark to the nightly sweep that gates on kv_evictions and batch-splitting counts. If it triggers a regression, fail the candidate set and send an alert.
devon: i can open a tiny PR adding `kv_churn` and `batch_split_count` probes into `scripts/bench/nightly_sweep.py` and adding an autotune-guard in `autotuner/core.py` — quick patch below:
```
# autotuner/core.py (patch)
+if metrics[kv_evictions] > 1.5 * baseline[kv_evictions] and seq_len >= 2048:
+    score -= 0.25  # penalize kernels that inflate KV churn on long sequences
```
and nightly_sweep.py update:
```
--include-probes=latency,p99,p95,kv_churn,batch_split_count
```
I'll push a branch `dev/kv-guard-nightly` after syncing with QA.
jon: one more ask: instrument the probe-aggregator to emit histogram buckets for batch_split_count so we can spot thresholding behavior (not just totals).
sasha: i can add the hist buckets. also we should capture a short flamegraph of memcopy and prefetch ops during the microprobe. helps confirm hypothesis.
phil: FYI, there were two other candidate kernels with minor wins on short seq that the tuner briefly considered last week. i'll fetch those logs and see if they also increase kv churn.
mara: plan of action:
1) devon to open PR with autotune guard & nightly probe inclusion (ETA: today EOD)
2) sasha to add batch_split histogram + flamegraph hook (ETA: tomorrow)
3) jon & phil to run expanded sweep across ampere/h100 to verify cross-arch impact (ETA: two days)
4) if nightly fails, block candidate promotion until a mitigation or revert

Please @here if you have objections. otherwise i'll create the incident ticket to track this regression. :white_check_mark:
jon: no objections. good call on the kv metric guard.
devon: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2481 — includes tests and a short-run job in CI. linking: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2481
ci-bot: [ci] infra/pull/2481 — microbench unit smoke ✓, nightly_sweep dry-run ✗ (kv_churn gate would have failed)
mara: perfect — that dry-run confirms the guard. rolling this into the nightly tomorrow and will keep candidate set frozen until we have a fix/opt. thanks everyone.
phil: noted. I'll start a deeper perf trace session to find whether memcopy is coming from prefetch or from cache-evict compaction.
sasha: will post flamegraphs when done.
devon: follow-up ticket opened: RH-1287 (autotune longseq safety + nightly probe).
mara: closing loop here — we'll reconvene after traces. :pray:
